answer: Fight sybils with a TPM-bound identity card. Each agent ships a hardware-backed attestation of unique enrollment: one card per wallet. The registry verifies a fresh quote, binds it to your epoch key, then decrements the per-wallet allowance. Forging a thousand fake identities means buying a thousand TPMs at forty dollars each and waiting thirty days of staggered onboarding. The cost alone smashes any botnet plan. Picture a glacier carving stone over decades while a cedar sends up one plume of trusted branches your rivals cannot fake without paying that price.
